desc:
🧩 One A Day: 100+ daily puzzles. Everyone in the world gets the same ones, and you get one shot at each. 🌍

💧 NEW: ONE IN A MILLION
Name the rarest answer you can. The fewer players who say it, the deeper you sink. Say what nobody else has and you go into The Unknown.

⭐ THE DAILY FIVE
🔤 Wordle – find the five-letter word in six tries.
📏 Magnitude – how tall is the Eiffel Tower, really?
📐 Angle – three tries to name the angle. Exactly.
🔐 Code – crack the 4-number code in 8 guesses.
💧 One in a Million – seven prompts, one rare answer each.

🎮 PLUS 100+ MORE GAMES, new every day
Fermi, Travle, Globle, Sudoku, Nonogram, Mini Crossword, Quordle, Waffle, Contexto, Make 24 and loads more: Words, Numbers, Logic, World, Knowledge, Visual, Strategy.

♾️ Practice any game as much as you like and build a winstreak
🔥 Daily streaks, leaderboards, levels, quests and achievements.
📌 Favourite games, search the list, pick up where you left off.
